caption:
105 boxes. 11,172 Korean syllables ✍️

Jamo mode combines your handwritten consonants and vowels into every Hangul syllable. That's about 2 printed sheets.

Want it to look even more like you? 2,350 mode has you write each common syllable yourself (about 27 sheets).

You get a .ttf font you can install and use in Word, PowerPoint and more.
